text.en:
Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 1276 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. The provisions of any existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, Central Bank of the Philippines is
hereby authorized to continue implementing its reward system for information leading to the confiscation and
forfeiture in favor of the National Government, of gold, foreign exchange and Philippine Currency held in
violation of existing laws and regulations: Provided, however, That the amount of reward shall be in such
amount as may be fixed by the Monetary Board, but in no case to exceed twenty per cent (20%) of the
proceeds of the forfeited gold, foreign exchange or Philippine Currency."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of February in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
